# Bridgistic

> Bridgistic is a WordPress plugin and local MCP bridge from WordPressistic LLC. It lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and other MCP clients act on WordPress through signed, scoped requests, with approvals, snapshots and an audit log. The administrator password is not the credential.

Bridgistic is published by WordPressistic LLC, doing business as WPistic, at 1209 Mountain Road PL NE, STE N, Albuquerque, NM 87110, US. Support: support@wpistic.com. The free plugin is GPL-2.0-or-later and the source is public. Paid plans are sold by Paddle as merchant of record. This file is rebuilt from the live pages whenever the site is built. Content date: 2026-10-23.

## Pages
- [Bridgistic: Safe AI Control for WordPress via MCP](https://bridgistic.app/): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and other MCP clients to WordPress with signed requests, scoped access, approvals, snapshots, rollback and audit logs.
- [Feature guide](https://bridgistic.app/features): Every Bridgistic feature, with what ships in the free plugin today and what is still marked coming soon on the paid plans.
- [Docs](https://bridgistic.app/docs): Install Bridgistic, create a Read-only key, and connect Claude, Codex, Gemini or ChatGPT. WordPress 6.4+ and PHP 8.0+.
- [Terms of Service](https://bridgistic.app/terms): Terms for the Bridgistic plugin, Bridgistic Pro, the dashboard and the relay.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bridgistic.app/privacy): What Bridgistic, its dashboard, relay and the WPistic license server store and send.
- [Refund Policy](https://bridgistic.app/refund-policy): Refunds for Bridgistic Pro monthly, yearly and Lifetime Deal purchases.
- [How purchases work](https://bridgistic.app/how-purchases-work): How a Bridgistic purchase is processed: Paddle, the WPistic license server, the plugin, the dashboard and the relay.
- [Sitemap](https://bridgistic.app/sitemap.html): Every public page on bridgistic.app.

## Pricing (as published)
- Free: $0. Local MCP bridge, GPL-2.0-or-later.
- Pro Lifetime Deal, while the welcome offer is open: $49 once, 1 license · 1 site, through 31 December 2026 or 100 licenses, whichever comes first.
- Pro Monthly: $12 USD per month, 1 license · 3 sites.
- Pro Yearly: $99 USD per year, 1 license · 3 sites.
- Every purchase has a 7-day refund guarantee. Taxes are calculated by Paddle at checkout.
